title: Potential and pitfalls of artificial intelligence to address disparities in epilepsy
title_zh: 人工智能应对癫痫差距的潜力与陷阱
abstract: A high proportion of people with epilepsy globally have limited access to the necessary expertise and resources for effective diagnosis and treatment. In this Review, Otte et al. examine how artificial intelligence tools can help to address disparities and improve global epilepsy care.
abstract_zh: 全球比例很高的癫痫患者缺乏有效诊断和治疗所需的专业知识和资源。本综述中，Otte 等人探讨了人工智能工具如何帮助缩小差距并改善全球癫痫医疗。
